notes.6-1:
Very common and easy interview question, use hashmaps and difference technique for optimal solution.

A good question for interview can be why do we first check then update/add to the map: It is because so that we accidentally don't take the same i for both indices since repetition of elements is not allowed. Eg is nums=[3,3] target=6 will accidentally return {0,0} which will be deemed wrong.
